pages.text: The survivors left books: a guild ledger, a physician's casebook, a stationmaster's log, a child's drawings, a pamphlet from beyond the river. Each blames something different. Read enough and you will know what happened; they never did.$(br2)They are not reprinted here. Look in the dead towns' chests, in mineshafts and dungeons, and in the pillagers' plunder.

The deeper pages are a reward: a town's bounty board under the $(bold)Archivist's Records$() decree pays in journals once the board trusts you ($(l:patchouli:towns/caravans)Bounties$()).$(br2)Keep what you find in a lectern at the capital. Someone else will want to read it.
